headline: Binance froze withdrawals after confirming a security breach it said affected over $5.7B, and bitcoin slipped below $80,000 as Coinbase and Strategy reported results.

market.asOf: Read about 22:15 UTC Thu 29 Oct (05:15 Friday Bangkok) from CryptoTicker's Binance timeline, because CoinGecko's and CoinMarketCap's coin pages could not be opened this run. At about 23:57 UTC the CoinGecko homepage showed BTC $77,866, ETH $2,247 and SOL $95.48, while the CoinMarketCap homepage showed BTC $79,788, ETH $2,305 and SOL $99.63; the two disagree, so check the live prices at the top of the page.

stories.title: Binance confirms a security breach and freezes withdrawals
stories.summary: Binance, the world's largest crypto exchange, froze withdrawals after a security incident on Thursday evening. Binance said the hack affected over $5.7B and that user funds remain safe, per CoinDesk. The story is still developing and the loss figures are still moving.
points: Outside estimates of the loss differ: about $3.55B to one wallet (analyst Spreek), up to $5.8B (Coinbase's Conor Grogan), and about $3.3B being investigated by Blockaid, per The Block.

Stablecoin issuers froze linked funds: Tether more than $1.57B of USDT and Circle more than $800M of USDC, per CoinDesk. A post by CZ quoted in the same report gave lower figures, about $971M and $823M.
Binance said it suspended withdrawals on multiple networks as a precaution, per TechCrunch. Former CEO CZ said he expects user funds to be fully covered.
Aave froze its lending markets so the attacker cannot borrow against stolen tokens, per CoinDesk. Nobody has said who is behind the attack.
If confirmed in the billions, it would be bigger than Bybit's roughly $1.4B hack in 2025, the previous record, per TechCrunch.

stories.title: Coinbase and Strategy report third-quarter results; both stocks dip after hours
stories.summary: Coinbase posted a profit helped by gains on its own crypto, while trading revenue kept shrinking. Strategy reported a $19.53B profit driven by its bitcoin.
points: Coinbase: revenue $1.22B and $2.51 a share, per CoinDesk, helped by a $715M gain on its crypto holdings. Net income was $718.7M and adjusted net income $77.7M, per the company.

Coinbase transaction revenue was $590M (down 44% from a year ago) and subscription and services revenue $570M, per Investing.com. Prediction markets passed $200M in annualized revenue, per the company.
Coinbase stock fell about 2.2% after hours to $157.10, per Investing.com.
Strategy held 848,517 BTC on 25 Oct at an average cost of about $75,446 each, per the company. Its stock fell about 3.5% after hours, per The Block.
Strategy's CFO Andrew Kang steps down on 5 Nov; Reza Virasteh becomes CFO on 1 Jan 2027, per the company.

stories.title: Bitcoin falls below $80,000 and leveraged bets are wiped out
stories.summary: Bitcoin slipped below $80,000 on Thursday as a tech-stock selloff and a hawkish Fed weighed on markets, then fell further on the Binance news. Forced selling by borrowed bets sped up the drop.
points: Earlier Thursday, bitcoin fell from above $81,700 to about $79,800 after Alphabet and Samsung's chip unit disappointed, per CoinDesk. The Fed held rates at 3.75%-4% on Wednesday.
After the Binance news, bitcoin hit $78,763 at 21:00 UTC and BNB fell about 6.8%, per CryptoTicker.
About $628M of positions were liquidated in one hour, about $607M of them bets on prices rising, per CryptoTicker.
'Liquidated' means traders who borrowed to bet were forced out of their positions, which adds selling pressure.

briefs.title: Polymarket resumes trading and promises full repayment
briefs.summary: Polymarket paused trading for about an hour after a security issue involving a third-party provider, then resumed, and said it is fully reimbursing affected traders, per AP.

briefs.title: NYSE owner ICE invests in TradeXYZ to bring Hyperliquid-style perpetual futures to the US
briefs.summary: ICE will run a new US market and clearing structure built on Hyperliquid, covering crypto, stocks, commodities and currencies. It needs regulatory approval and has no launch date.

briefs.title: Franklin Templeton launches ETFs that turn stock dividends into bitcoin
briefs.summary: Franklin Templeton has launched FBEQ (0.09% fee) and FIBT (0.19% fee), which hold about 5% in bitcoin, per 24/7 Wall St.

briefs.title: Bitcoin funds took in money on Wednesday; ether funds lost money
briefs.summary: US spot bitcoin ETFs took in $137.3M on 28 Oct, while ether ETFs saw $21.4M of outflows, per KuCoin News. Thursday's figures were not out yet.

briefs.title: US jobless claims stay near multi-decade lows
briefs.summary: Weekly jobless claims were 194K against 199K expected, per Reuters via Investing.com.
